basic_details.job_title: Bihar Vidhan Sabha Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 54 Assistant Caretaker, Assistant Section Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: Graduates can apply online for 54 posts in the Bihar Legislative Assembly Secretariat (Bihar Vidhan Sabha Sachivalaya), Patna – 50 Assistant Section Officer (Sahayak Prashakha Padadhikari, Pay Level 7, Rs. 44,900-1,42,400) and 4 Assistant Caretaker (Sahayak Avdhayak, Pay Level 4, Rs. 25,500-81,100) posts under Advertisement No. 01/2024. The application window is open from 7 November 2026 (11:00 AM) to 27 November 2026, and candidates who applied for these posts earlier need not apply again.

how_to_apply: Open the Apply Online link given in the advertisement; detailed instructions are on the Bihar Vidhan Sabha Sachivalaya website, https://vidhansabha.bihar.gov.in.
Register and fill the online form between 7 November 2026 (11:00 AM) and 27 November 2026, using your own working mobile number and email ID.
Tick the box beside each post you are applying for.
Upload scanned copies of your educational and reservation certificates, a recent photograph and your signature, and check that the images are clear.
Pay the fee by Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card; bank charges are added to the fee. Print and keep the bank receipt.
After final submission, log in again and download the filled form from the "Download Filled Application Section" on the dashboard; print two copies.
Check that every page of the printout shows the Bar Code and the Application Number; without either, the application is treated as incomplete and is not accepted.

Printed, typed or handwritten applications outside the online form are not accepted. Candidates who already applied in the 2024 windows need not apply again. The notice does not give a separate last date for fee payment in the new window.

The fee is not refundable. SC/ST candidates who pay the SC/ST fee but later fail to produce the certificate, or whose certificate is doubted, may be disqualified; they may voluntarily pay the fee for general candidates to keep their candidature safe.
SC and ST: caste certificate and permanent residence (domicile) certificate.
BC and EBC: caste certificate, permanent residence certificate and non-creamy layer certificate.
Unmarried or married women: caste and non-creamy layer certificates issued from the father's permanent address.
Caste and residence certificates must be issued by the Circle Officer (Anchaladhikari) of the permanent residence circle notified by the State Government.
EWS: income and asset certificate in Annexure-1 (Form-1) of the government notification, issued by the competent authority.
Grandchildren of freedom fighters: certificate signed by the District Magistrate of the home district or an officer authorised by him, and an identity card.
Persons with disabilities: certificate of at least 40% disability in the prescribed form from the Medical Board.

content_sections.heading: Bihar Vidhan Sabha Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Bihar Vidhan Sabha Sachivalaya (Bihar Legislative Assembly Secretariat), Patna
Pay Level 7 (Rs. 44,900-1,42,400) and Pay Level 4 (Rs. 25,500-81,100), plus other admissible allowances as per rules
Graduate or equivalent degree from a recognised university
Minimum 21 years (as on 01-08-2023); maximum 37 to 42 years by category

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Within these 50 posts, horizontal reservation is also given to candidates with disabilities: 1 post for the blind and low vision category and 1 post for the deaf and hard of hearing category. One post is reserved under the 2% horizontal reservation for grandsons and granddaughters (children of a son or daughter) of former freedom fighters of Bihar.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India. For both posts – Assistant Section Officer and Assistant Caretaker – the candidate must hold a graduate or equivalent degree from a university recognised by the State Government or the Central Government by the last date for filling the online application. A candidate with the required qualification may apply for more than one post. A separate application for each post is not needed: ticking the box beside the posts shown in the registration form makes the candidate an applicant for each ticked post, and only one fee is payable. If two candidates are in contention for one post, the desirable qualification fixed for that post decides. The post-wise desirable qualification is given in the Schedule attached to the Bihar Vidhan Sabha Sachivalaya (Recruitment and Service Conditions) Rules, 2018. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post. The minimum age is 21 years on 01-08-2023. Age is counted from the date of birth recorded in the matriculation or equivalent certificate. The maximum age limit is: Reservation benefit is only for candidates whose permanent residence is in Bihar; residents of other states do not get reservation. Reservation must be claimed in the column of the online form; the permanent address given in the online form alone is accepted for reservation. Reservation for EWS is 10%, for persons with disabilities 4% (horizontal) and for women 35% (horizontal), subject to vacancies and rules. The reservation category cannot be corrected or changed during the appointment process. Claims are valid only if all certificates are produced by the date fixed by the Vidhan Sabha Sachivalaya.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bihar Vidhan Sabha Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Printed, typed or handwritten applications outside the online form are not accepted. Candidates who already applied in the 2024 windows need not apply again. The notice does not give a separate last date for fee payment in the new window. The fee is not refundable. SC/ST candidates who pay the SC/ST fee but later fail to produce the certificate, or whose certificate is doubted, may be disqualified; they may voluntarily pay the fee for general candidates to keep their candidature safe. SC and ST: caste certificate and permanent residence (domicile) certificate. BC and EBC: caste certificate, permanent residence certificate and non-creamy layer certificate. Unmarried or married women: caste and non-creamy layer certificates issued from the father's permanent address. Caste and residence certificates must be issued by the Circle Officer (Anchaladhikari) of the permanent residence circle notified by the State Government. EWS: income and asset certificate in Annexure-1 (Form-1) of the government notification, issued by the competent authority. Grandchildren of freedom fighters: certificate signed by the District Magistrate of the home district or an officer authorised by him, and an identity card. Persons with disabilities: certificate of at least 40% disability in the prescribed form from the Medical Board.

rows.category: Men of EBC, BC, EWS and Unreserved categories who are original residents of Bihar; candidates from outside Bihar of any category (women and men)
SC, ST and PwD (40% or more) candidates who are original residents of Bihar; women of all categories who are original residents of Bihar

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is in two stages: a Preliminary Examination (objective, multiple choice, OMR answer sheet) and a descriptive Main Examination. A post-wise merit list is prepared on the basis of the Main Examination. Each question carries 4 marks; 1 mark is deducted for each wrong answer. The medium is Hindi/English; if the Hindi and English papers differ, the English version is valid. Minimum qualifying marks: General 40%, Backward Class 36.5%, Extremely Backward Class 34%, SC/ST, women and candidates with disabilities 32%. If many applications are received, the preliminary may be held in more than one phase, and results will be prepared through normalisation. Syllabus: General Studies covers current events, India and its neighbouring countries, history, culture, geography, economy, polity and Constitution, Panchayati Raj and Bihar's role in the freedom movement; General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) and Mathematics are broadly of matriculation level; Mental Ability covers verbal and non-verbal reasoning, number series, coding and decoding.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The examination programme will be published separately on the Bihar Vidhan Sabha website.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Bihar Vidhan Sabha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 54 posts under Advertisement No. 01/2024: 50 Assistant Section Officer and 4 Assistant Caretaker. The number of posts may decrease or increase.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 27 November 2026; applications open on 7 November 2026 at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Do I need to apply again if I applied in 2024?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who have already applied for these posts need not apply again.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Assistant Section Officer and Assistant Caretaker?
faq.answer: A graduate or equivalent degree from a university recognised by the State or Central Government, held by the last date of the online application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years on 01-08-2023; the maximum is 37 years for Unreserved men, 40 years for Unreserved women and BC/EBC candidates, and 42 years for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Assistant Section Officer gets Pay Level 7 (Rs. 44,900-1,42,400) and Assistant Caretaker Pay Level 4 (Rs. 25,500-81,100), plus other admissible allowances as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 600 for Bihar-domicile EBC, BC, EWS and Unreserved men and for all candidates from outside Bihar; Rs. 150 for Bihar-domicile SC, ST, PwD (40% or more) and all Bihar-domicile women.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: An objective Preliminary Examination of 100 questions and 400 marks with 1 mark negative marking, followed by a descriptive Main Examination; the merit list is based on the Main Examination.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for both posts with one fee?
faq.answer: Yes. Eligible candidates tick both posts in the registration form; only one application and one fee are needed.
